Define the fresh-produce use Identify the fruit or vegetable, packed quantity, storage temperature and handling route. Confirm the opening, any ventilation requirement and the intended storage period. Do not select a sealed structure solely from the appearance of an empty produce bag. Check the bottom gusset Confirm the bottom gusset, filled footprint and stability at the intended fill level. Keep artwork clear of the base fold and seals. Review the filled sample against shelf depth before fixing the dieline. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents. Include any valve as a separate specified component. Resolve the material references The material and film entries describe different levels of detail or alternative options. Choose one final layer structure in the quotation; do not combine the lists into an assumed laminate. Confirm layer order, thicknesses, sealant and the testing needed for the intended contents. Approve the artwork and print route Share artwork status, the number of designs and quantity per design. Ask the quotation to identify the selected printing and finishing processes rather than assuming every listed reference applies. Approve the dieline, color proof and clear seal areas before production.
